Project Coordinator, Clinical Operations
Riverbend Health System | Columbus, OH | Full time, hybrid

About the role
Riverbend Health System is looking for a Project Coordinator to support our Clinical Operations team as we open two new outpatient clinics and roll out a new scheduling system across 14 sites. You will keep projects on track, keep stakeholders informed, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

What you will do
- Coordinate project timelines, milestones, and deliverables across multiple concurrent projects
- Schedule and run weekly status meetings; take notes and track action items to closure
- Maintain project plans, RAID logs, and status reports in Smartsheet and Microsoft Project
- Work with clinical managers, IT, facilities, and vendors to resolve issues and remove blockers
- Track budgets and purchase orders and flag variances to the project manager
- Prepare dashboards and reports in Excel for leadership
- Support training and go-live readiness for frontline staff

What we are looking for
- 3+ years of experience coordinating projects or operations
- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
- Excellent written and verbal communication
- Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables and VLOOKUP
- Experience with Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, or a similar project management tool
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
- Bachelor's degree in business, healthcare administration, or a related field, or equivalent experience

Nice to have
- CAPM or PMP certification
- Experience in a healthcare or clinical setting
- Familiarity with Epic or another electronic health record

We offer competitive pay, medical and dental coverage, a 403(b) with match, and tuition assistance.
